description.value: Passive (Mal voice). While Gilbert is on stage, no one may bring flash photography, lit cigarettes, or weapon discharge into the orchestra section without winning a Diplomacy contest vs. Gilbert's Resolve. Gilbert reframes any direct violence against him as poor manners and continues sweeping. He cannot be Compelled by threat. The mop is his witness.

sources: Gilbert, Eternally Cleaning Not Leaning Theater Attendant
